notes:
First test build.

- Sign in with Microsoft (several accounts), or a test offline account.
- Instances for any Minecraft version with Fabric, Quilt, NeoForge or Forge.
  Groups, favourites, icons, duplicate, play time.
- Browse and install mods, resource packs and shaders from Modrinth, Cytra,
  GitHub or a link. Dependencies are added for you, problems are flagged
  before you play, and updates show their changelogs.
- Import .mrpack, CurseForge and Prism/MultiMC packs, or copy instances from
  Prism, MultiMC, the official launcher, the Modrinth App and the CurseForge app.
  Export as .mrpack, CurseForge zip or a plain zip.
- Worlds (details, notes, stats, backups), Litematica schematics, screenshots.
- Servers with live status and one-click join.
- Skins and capes with a 3D preview and a skin library.
- Crash helper that explains common crashes, and one-click log sharing.
- Shared Masa and Cytra settings across instances.
- Storage clean-up and a Java manager.
- Theme editor: layouts, colour schemes, your own colours, picture or video
  backgrounds, fonts. Ctrl+K to jump anywhere.
- While you play, Alloy closes its window to free memory and waits in the tray.
